policy.raw_official_redistribution: do_not_publish_by_default; publish source attribution, metadata, hashes, tests, and necessary aggregates
policy.date_policy: Normalize source ROC dates to ISO-8601 before manifesting. data_date is the observation/publication date; trading_date is only populated for trading-session facts; fetched_at is timezone-aware collection time.
policy.calendar_policy: Trading-day freshness must use the official TWSE/TPEx calendar. Weekday-only logic is allowed only in isolated tests with explicit holidays supplied.

live_audit_samples.purpose: Endpoint reachability and schema evidence only; row counts are not contractual minimums.

twse_attention.use_policy: normalized metadata and necessary risk aggregates; no raw response redistribution by default

twse_disposition.use_policy: normalized metadata and necessary risk aggregates; no raw response redistribution by default

twse_near_disposition.use_policy: use the exchange warning as the trigger signal; do not invent missing trigger counts

tpex_attention.use_policy: normalized metadata and necessary risk aggregates; no raw response redistribution by default

tpex_disposition.use_policy: normalized metadata and necessary risk aggregates; no raw response redistribution by default

tpex_near_disposition.use_policy: use the exchange warning as the trigger signal; do not invent missing trigger counts

attention_disposition_derived.access: derived normalized risk snapshot; official response hashes and missing states remain visible
attention_disposition_derived.source_frequency: each trading day after official announcements

daily_decisions_derived.access: derived from normalized project artifacts; no raw local exports are published

daily_market_flow_derived.access: derived aggregate plus normalized ordinary-equity rankings; source partitions and missing states remain visible
daily_market_flow_derived.source_frequency: each trading day after official institutional feeds
daily_market_flow_derived.use_policy: publish exact official market amount summaries and normalized ordinary-equity net-buy/sell rankings; exclude ETF, ETN, warrants, TDR, bonds, preferred shares and other non-common-equity instruments from rankings; preserve official source attribution

weekly_holder_risers_derived.access: derived aggregate from compact official TDCC 400-plus-lot current and historical queries; raw TDCC rows are not persisted or published
weekly_holder_risers_derived.use_policy: publish the latest-week positive-change Top 50 from the newest contiguous seven-snapshot window with six aligned week-over-week ownership changes; expose observation date and freshness, fail closed on incomplete leading candidates, and do not infer a buy signal from ownership change

finmind_normalized_fallback.access: existing normalized fallback; credentials local-only when required
finmind_normalized_fallback.use_policy: fallback_only; never presented as official; manifest must expose fallback.used, reason, data date, and source id
